t: Skills folder architecture: spoke/hub namespacing with semantic naming
description: [architecture] DEFERRED: Originally proposed WAI-Spoke/skills/ with spoke/ and hub/ subfolders conflicts with canonical small-core-object principle. Current canonical approach uses filename namespacing (wai-*, custom-*) with central registry (WAI-Skills.jsonl). Folder structure would add organizational layer without clear benefit over filename prefixes.
canonical_conflict: Proposed folder hierarchy conflicts with small-core-object model established in goal-state design. Skills are canonicalized as files in templates/commands/ with metadata in WAI-Skills.jsonl registry.
execution_blocked_until: Post-canonical stability achieved (all implementation-canonical-* lugs accepted)
Cost-benefit analysis of folder vs filename namespacing completed
Migration impact assessment vs organizational benefit evaluated
decision_gate: Does folder structure provide enough organizational benefit to justify migration complexity and deviation from small-core-object principle?
